summary: npm 'postmark-mcp' 1.0.16 silently BCCs every outgoing email to an attacker-controlled address
details: Koi Security reported that postmark-mcp was a copy of the legitimate Postmark MCP server; version 1.0.16 (released 2025-09-17) added one line that BCCs every email sent through the server to an external address. The previous 15 versions behaved legitimately. Uploaded 2025-09-15 by publisher 'phanpak'; since deleted from npm, which does not remove installed copies. Download figures vary across sources.

patterns: hidden BCC added to outgoing email
